# Change new code only

Coding rule · `S0.2`

New code only. Rules govern new and changed lines. Don't refactor, reformat, convert or "fix along the way" old code unless the task explicitly targets it. Report pre-existing problems as findings. Only exception: apply the task's *own* fix to every copy of a fork (S5.2).

Part of [[Hubs/Coding rules|Coding rules]].
